experiment_template.research_question: Does one bounded phase-tagged projection at the earliest receipt-confirmed effect, terminal candidate, or typed pressure boundary improve GLM-5.3-flash useful-context completion at 8K while reducing or preserving cumulative tokens?
stop_conditions: Any unbounded unknown usage, retry, asymmetric score, integrity failure, or cost-cap violation stops before the next task.
Stop immediately when six eligible pairs become mathematically unreachable.

records.falsifier: Fewer than six pairs are eligible, any boundary or ancestry proof fails, treatment aggregate tokens exceed control, any quality metric degrades, or macro Span-F1 gain is below 0.05.
records.mechanism: Fork at the earliest receipt-confirmed effect; otherwise fork at the first terminal candidate or typed response, output, or context pressure. Present treatment one phase-tagged decision-state/v1 projection and control the same neutral review without it.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash fresh scoreable 8K ContextBench development tasks at the 96K cumulative input-plus-output tier.
records.statement: A universal decision boundary covering effectful and no-effect trajectories can expose compact observable reasoning state with sufficient paired coverage and improve quality per cumulative token.
